acceptance.assertion: Immediately before prepare-intent and again before apply, protected heimgewebe/bureau main is freshly observed; the exact target contains this authority's protected publication merge, registered main 5fc0075fbde810bd988ca55f24c38a94e7a772f6 and all then-current legitimate protected-main merges, and validate (3.10), validate (3.12), and registry-registration-preflight/freshness are successful for the exact target.

Immediately before prepare-intent and again before apply, active deployment-manifest source_commit and canonical Registry source identity are equal, and that active source is exactly registered source 8da2115b296cbe5c0e3aec53de694c3d33492e4a or a later verified Git ancestor of the freshly selected target main. Any identity mismatch, divergence, unavailable ancestry proof or target drift blocks the runtime effect fail-closed.

This authority starts at most one runtime effect. Failed, unclear, timeout or transport-ambiguous outcomes are read back from intent, attempt/result, manifest, launcher, package, snapshot and authority-consumption evidence before any further action; no blind retry is permitted.

After a successful refresh, deployment manifest, immutable release, package tree, launcher pair and canonical Registry snapshot bind the same freshly observed source commit, and Bureau runtime identity is integrity-valid at that exact target.

The authority is consumed exactly once after successful immutable readback and grants only Bureau runtime/Registry convergence. After terminal closeout and lease release, HEIM-PC-NIXOS-MIGRATION-V1-T010 resumes through its own artifact-only authority. This runtime authority grants no T010 artifact creation, NixOS, storage, EFI, firmware, reboot, queue, claim, dispatch, task-supply, product-code, foreign-work or general repository mutation authority.

approval.note: Publication, missing-only adoption and proof-bearing activation are preparation only. No Bureau runtime effect is authorized by this TaskSpec publication or by any historical approval.
